extensionDescription.message: Restrict non-proxied WebRTC UDP, view the active policy, and restore your original settings.

tip.message: Non-proxied UDP only · Reload pages after switching

detailsLimits.message: This does not fully disable WebRTC or guarantee that all IP addresses are hidden. Calls and file transfers may be affected.

detailsRestore.message: Restoring only removes this extension's changes. The browser's underlying policy still applies.

privacy.message: Runs locally · No browsing history collected

descriptionLocked.message: Controlled by another extension or browser policy. Changes are unavailable.

descriptionOwned.message: Restriction is active. You can restore your settings anytime.

descriptionRestricted.message: The browser's underlying policy already applies this restriction.

descriptionOriginal.message: No restriction applied by this extension. Using the browser's original policy.

descriptionUnavailable.message: Try again or check browser compatibility.

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errorUnsupported.message: This browser does not support WebRTC privacy settings.

errorLocked.message: Another extension or browser policy controls this setting. It cannot be changed.

errorNotApplied.message: The restriction did not take effect. Check other extensions or browser policies.

errorRestore.message: Could not remove this extension's setting. Please try again.

noticeRestoredRestricted.message: Changes removed. The underlying policy still restricts UDP.

noticeRestored.message: Original settings restored. Reload the page.

noticeEnabled.message: Restriction is active. Reload the page.

toolbarLocked.message: WebRTC: controlled by another extension or browser policy

toolbarUnavailable.message: WebRTC status unavailable. Open the extension for details.
